notes: Two sayings each with its own isnad: Simak heard Jabir (saying 1); Simak then asked «القوم», who answered «قال: كلهم من قريش» (saying 2, last link unnamed)
«القوم» is a group the text does not name: kept as unnamed, not filled from memory
«قال: كلهم من قريش» may stand for Jabir or the Prophet; the text does not settle it
